subject.title: No longer showing in activity bar

question: Is the shipped v0.41.0 Tahoe no-window recovery enough to close this broader missing-menu-bar-icon report without fresh reporter confirmation?
rationale: The source and release now cover a plausible root cause, but the owner already asked for specific diagnostics and this issue lacks evidence tying the reporter's v0.37.2 symptom to the fixed no-window variant.

options.title: Keep collecting current-build diagnostics
options.body: Leave this open until an affected user retests v0.41.0 or newer and provides the requested Debug log, Menu Bar state, menu-manager, and display details.

options.title: Close as covered by v0.41.0
options.body: Close only if the maintainer is comfortable treating the original symptom as the same root cause fixed by https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/issues/1945 despite missing confirmation.

options.title: Split a narrower follow-up
options.body: If new logs show a different visibility state, keep this as context and open or link a focused issue for that specific watcher gap.

recommendation.title: Keep collecting current-build diagnostics
recommendation.body: Leave this open until an affected user retests v0.41.0 or newer and provides the requested Debug log, Menu Bar state, menu-manager, and display details.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the owner diagnostic request and the recent status-item recovery/release work most directly relevant to the close-or-wait decision.
